posts.cooked:
Here is how I got it. it was accidental.

I had 12 Constructs in play.

Villain: Ambuscade

Environment: Dok'Thorath Capital

AA: Dynamic Siphon

Captain Cosmic: 2 x Automatous Blade, Cosmic Crest

Fanatic: Cosmic Weapon

Haka: Wounding Buffer, 2 x Vitality Conduit, Energy bracer, Augmented Ally, Wounding Buffer

Tempest: Augmented Ally

I got it on the environment Turn. The orbital laser came out, and hit all 12 constructs (for 0 because of Energy immunity). I got it unlocked after the final construct was targeted.

I believe it has to be to have all the types different constructs in play, and survive a hit to all of them.
